chapter: New Orleans Rhythm Kings and Tin Roof Blues
title: Wingy Manone, In a Mood and money
summary: He claims Wingy wrote the riff behind In the Mood and collected from Glenn Miller.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: You know, Wingy, you know that thing that the late Glenn Miller made, In a Mood? Yeah. That was Wingy's tune.
He had the proof that he wrote, he had a record of Tall Paper Stomp, he called it.

And he got a lot of money out of that from Glenn Miller. He didn't. Wingy's a pretty shrewd boy when it comes to money. Yeah. He acts illiterate but he's pretty smart. He's like Maxie Rosenblum. Yeah. Musical Maxie Rosenblum.
